reason: REA is an agent-oriented reverse-engineering and software investigation tool that gathers structured evidence from applications, native binaries, and selected runtime environments through CLI and MCP workflows.

summaries.zh: REA 是一个面向智能体的软件逆向工程与调查工具，可通过 CLI 和 MCP 分析应用程序、原生二进制文件及部分运行时环境并整理证据。
summaries.en: REA is an agent-oriented reverse-engineering and software investigation tool that analyzes applications, native binaries, and selected runtime environments through CLI and MCP workflows while organizing supporting evidence.

capabilities: Local application and native binary analysis
Decompilation, disassembly, static inspection, and function dossier generation
Passive observation of websites, Electron pages, and Node/Electron runtime behavior
Controlled process capture and evidence recording
Optional local setup and configuration of MCP integrations and analysis providers
